name: Promises Of Housing
overview: Scripture reveals God's gracious promises concerning housing as a tangible blessing for His people, exemplified in His call to Abram to leave his father's house for a land He would show (Genesis 12:1) and the assurance of inheriting cities and houses filled with good things not built or filled by their own hands (Deuteronomy 6:10-11). These promises underscore God's provision and faithfulness, encouraging believers to serve the Lord wholeheartedly in their homes (Joshua 24:15) while trusting that He withholds no good thing from those who walk uprightly (Psalms 84:11). Ultimately, God's plans for His people include peace and a hopeful future, affirming His care over their dwelling places (Jeremiah 29:11).
